repo_notes.author: GamerTrust backend
repo_notes.content:
This repository is the GamerTrust marketplace backend (gt-backend), not a generic Node boilerplate. It is a modular monolith: one Express process, one MongoDB database, modules as bounded contexts (identity, catalog, listings, verification, trust, search, favorites, media). Folder spelling is mandatory: infraestructure (with e) and configuration (singular). Domain must not import Infraestructure (no Mongoose, IM*, concrete SQS in domain). Business rules live in Service; Repository returns null when missing and must not throw product 404/409; Controllers are thin HTTP adapters.

HTTP contract source of truth is src/contracts/service.yaml (OpenAPI). Human API docs are generated into docs/en/api/ and docs/pt-BR/api/ (yarn docs:api). Do not invent a wiki page per REST endpoint — link those trees instead. Public signup is POST /auth/register, not POST /users (admin-only). Identity comes only from the first-party access JWT; client-sent x-user-id / x-user-groups are untrusted. Messaging transport as implemented is SNS+SQS (LocalStack in docker-compose); domain contracts are transport-neutral (producer.interface.ts). Do not document Kafka as the current transport.

Product rules: trust greater than volume — never display a verification seal unless the API returns a granted/active seal. Product (catalog model, /products) is not Listing (unit offer, /listings). AI must not invent attributes, condition, warranty, or seals. Architecture decisions (ARCH-*, DEC-*) live in docs/architecture/. Entity catalog in docs/entities/. Human project docs: docs/en/ and docs/pt-BR/. Working SDD artifacts in docs/specs/ are not published product docs.

pages.title: Project Overview
pages.purpose: What gt-backend is: GamerTrust Phase 1 modular monolith, stack (Express, MongoDB, OpenAPI), documentation surfaces (docs/en, docs/pt-BR, OpenAPI, this wiki), and non-negotiable product rules (trust > volume, Product ≠ Listing, no invented seals).

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Local setup: yarn install, docker compose MongoDB replica set, .env (DATABASE_URI, PORT, CORS, S3_USE_MEMORY, seed admin), yarn dev, GET /health, yarn seed:local, tests and yarn docs:api. Point to docs/en/getting-started.md.

pages.title: Layered Architecture
pages.purpose: Domain / Application / Infraestructure / Configuration / Contracts: what each layer owns, entity vs service vs repository, factories in src/configuration/factory, naming I* IM* E*. Cite AGENTS.md and docs/architecture-and-layers.md. Folder spelling infraestructure and configuration.

pages.title: Module Map
pages.purpose: Phase 1 bounded contexts, collection ownership, sync ports vs events, Product ≠ Listing. Summarize docs/architecture/02-module-map.md (ARCH-002). Later phases (orders, payments) are not HTTP in this MVP.

pages.title: HTTP conventions and OpenAPI
pages.purpose: service.yaml as source of truth, express-openapi-validator, public vs Bearer vs backoffice vs admin vs owner-or-admin, translated errors EErrorCode, pagination, mass-assignment ban. Public signup POST /auth/register. Point to docs/en/api and docs/pt-BR/api for per-operation contracts.

pages.title: Identity and Auth
pages.purpose: First-party JWT + opaque refresh (not Cognito), User without password, credentials and refresh_sessions, profiles, CEP lookup, events identity.user.registered and identity.user.verified. Cover src/application/controllers/auth.controller.ts and identity domain. POST /users is ADMIN.

pages.title: Catalog
pages.purpose: Categories, services taxonomy (DEC-024), products as models, attribute-schema, price_history. Client must not invent form fields. Events catalog.*.

pages.title: Listings
pages.purpose: Unit offers, quantity 1, ownership in Service via ActorContext, state machine DRAFT → SUBMITTED → PUBLISHED, pause. Events listings.listing.*. Publish is backoffice after verification.

pages.title: Verification and Trust
pages.purpose: Verification cases, evidence (restricted media), seals (show only when granted), TrustScore as recompute over trust_events ledger, seller levels. Never conflate user identity verify with a listing seal.

pages.title: Search
pages.purpose: search_documents read model (rebuildable), GET /search over PUBLISHED listings, synonyms as projection of catalog taxonomy, POST /search/reconcile operational. Events consumed from listings, catalog, trust.

pages.title: Favorites
pages.purpose: Saved product or listing; userId from Bearer token not body. Alerts are Phase 2.

pages.title: Media
pages.purpose: Upload grants, complete, asset metadata READY, content grants, S3 or S3_USE_MEMORY. Attach asset id to Listing.media. Restricted evidence vs public listing media.

pages.title: Inter-module communication
pages.purpose: When to use sync client ports vs domain events vs event-fed read models. No cross-module domain imports. IMediaClient pattern, ActorContext on ports, system actor on handlers. Point to docs/en/architecture/communication.md and ARCH-003.

pages.title: Messaging and events
pages.purpose: Asynchronous runtime: IEventEnvelope fields, DispatchingEventPublisher, in-process dispatch vs SQS_CONSUMERS_ENABLED, SqsEventPublisher env (SNS_TOPIC_ARN, SQS_QUEUE_URL, MESSAGING_DISABLED), DomainEventRouterFactory handler map as implemented, publish-after-commit, at-least-once idempotency, how to add an event. Target topology SNS per event × SQS per consumer (ARCH-005). Do not describe Kafka as current transport. Point to docs/en/architecture/messaging.md.

pages.title: Persistence
pages.purpose: MongoDB/Mongoose, IM* vs I*, adapters, replica set for transactions, no cross-module Mongo transactions (DEC-040), repository null-if-missing pattern.

pages.title: Security
pages.purpose: authorizeByGroup on routes, ownership in Service, no secrets in code/logs, no raw req into Mongo filters, ActorContext from JWT only, LGPD/PII/evidence rules from docs/architecture/07-security.md.

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: Jest unit and integration under src/__tests__/, mongodb-memory-server for int tests, coverage target 80%, spies on messaging interfaces (never a real broker in Jest).

pages.title: How to add an endpoint
pages.purpose: Change controller + service + OpenAPI service.yaml together, explicit security, tests, then yarn docs:api. Overlay PRODUCT_GAIN in scripts/generate-frontend-api-docs.js for both locales. Do not add a DeepWiki page per endpoint. Cite docs/en/contributing.md.

pages.title: Where to find API docs
pages.purpose: Map generated docs: docs/en/api and docs/pt-BR/api (README, request.md, response.md, parameters.md, examples.md, curl.sh). Deprecated docs/frontend-api redirects here. OpenAPI file src/contracts/service.yaml. Project hubs docs/en/README.md and docs/pt-BR/README.md.
